content:
Context: Conditions to be fulfilled.-

- (ix) Benefit of Pro forma Promotion will be given only against a vacancy of more than 90 days. For this purpose, chain of vacancies will not be considered.  
Benefit in other cases.Admissible to an officer during training / instruction in India/ deputation abroad for training/ deputation to Territorial Army on annual training/ course of instruction / emergency.  
Not admissible to one who is deputed to hold a regularly constituted ex cadre post abroad and whose pay is regulated under special orders.
